detail: In the round session itself (no background agent), commit the pending stepOrder.parity.test.ts fix on its own, then start `pnpm dev` and run `packages/studio/e2e/zz-caps-walk.spec.ts` with the Playwright CLI in the foreground, fixing the driver until it reaches the layout caps screenshot, the companion banner and the downloaded `.kmn` with `&CasedKeys`/`&VERSION`, then save the walk screenshots, tick T031/T032 and commit and push.
